name: apple-mail
description: Gmail-like draft management, scheduled sends, and sending identity control for Apple Mail on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Gmail-like drafts, scheduled sends, and sender identities.
interface.longDescription: Manage Apple Mail with stable draft IDs, persistent future send schedules, in-place draft updates, explicit sending identities and aliases, and confirmation-gated sending and deletion.
defaultPrompt: List my Apple Mail drafts and verify their From identities.
Schedule these reviewed Apple Mail drafts for tomorrow morning.
Show every sending identity configured in Apple Mail.
